results.title: 3,113 Kaduna Women Get Skills, Start-up Support To Boost Livelihoods
results.content: A total of 3,113 women in Kaduna State have acquired vocational skills and received start-up materials to establish their businesses. results.title: Soaring House Rents Force Ondo Residents Out Of Akure
results.content: Rising house rents in Akure, the Ondo State capital, are forcing some residents, particularly low-income earners, to relocate to the neighbouring communities and their hometowns where accommodation is relatively cheaper.
